title: Storage cleanup assistant
description: Scan the system disk and see space usage by real file path.
readOnlyDescription: The background scan reads names, sizes, and other metadata until complete. It never reads file contents or modifies, moves, or uploads files.
failed: The storage scan could not finish

access.title: Allow access to the whole system disk
access.description: macOS protects Mail, Messages, other app data, and similar locations. Full Disk Access lets the space map be as complete as possible; StatusOrbit still reads metadata such as names, sizes, and dates only.
access.waiting: System Settings is open. If StatusOrbit is missing, click + below the list and select StatusOrbit.app. Enable it, then return to start scanning automatically.
access.unknown: Access could not be confirmed. You can still open System Settings or run a limited scan.
access.bundleMissingTitle: This process cannot be added to the access list
access.bundleMissingDescription: macOS cannot authorize a development process here. Install StatusOrbit.app and reopen it from Applications; a limited scan is still available.
access.privacy: macOS controls this permission and you can turn it off at any time. StatusOrbit never reads file contents or changes files during a scan.

estimateBoundary: This is an estimate for caches and trash, not a recommendation to remove everything.

snapshot.retained: Saved on this device; changes are checked as you browse

cached.title: Previous scan restored
cached.description: Keep exploring without waiting for another scan. StatusOrbit checks a directory for changes only when you browse into it.

expired.title: This result is over 24 hours old
expired.description: StatusOrbit keeps the map available so you can continue exploring. Refresh it before acting on cleanup choices.

categories.title: What this space is commonly used for

map.title: Where the space went
map.description: Sector area represents allocated disk space. Related hues belong to one folder branch; gray sectors are files.
map.descriptionPath: Shown by real path across the system disk: each ring is the next directory level, and sector area represents allocated disk space.
map.descriptionCategory: The same scan is regrouped by common purpose. Categories are a supporting view, not the real directory hierarchy.
map.restrictedHint: The operating system did not grant read access; this item cannot be collected
map.noDeeperBreakdown: No deeper directory grouping is available at this level.
map.loadDeeperHint: Select this folder to load the next level without rescanning the whole computer.
map.directActionHint: Hold a sector and drag it to the cleanup basket at the lower-left of the map
map.protectedSelectionHint: System paths, grouped nodes, and the home root are view-only; only specific items inside your home folder can enter the basket
map.trashRootProtected: The Trash folder itself is protected; enter it and select the specific contents you want to remove

basket.title: Cleanup basket
basket.empty: Hold a sector and drag it here to collect items first
basket.release: Release to add to the basket
basket.collectedHint: Already collected; remove it from the basket below or continue reviewing
basket.partial: Deleted {{deletedCount}} items; {{failedCount}} could not be handled

deleteResult.cancelledNoDeletion: Deletion stopped before any item was fully removed
deleteResult.reclaimed: Allocated space verified before deletion: about {{size}}

freshness.expired: This scan is old; a rescan is recommended
freshness.changed: This folder changed; sizes may be inaccurate

deleteDialog.title: Review before permanent deletion
deleteDialog.description: Confirming deletes these items directly from disk instead of moving them to Trash.
deleteDialog.changedWarning: {{count}} items differ from the previous view. Sizes and item counts were updated; refresh again before confirming.
deleteDialog.preparing: Rechecking paths and current file state…
deleteDialog.deleteConfirmTitle: I understand these items will be permanently deleted
deleteDialog.deleteConfirmDescription: Files will not enter Trash. Downloads, settings, and personal data may not be reproducible.
deleteDialog.cancelHint: Completed deletions cannot be restored. StatusOrbit will stop after the current file operation.

errors.protected_cleanup_path: StatusOrbit will not delete your home directory or the Trash folder itself.
errors.cleanup_target_outside_home: For safety, StatusOrbit only handles content inside your personal folder.
errors.cleanup_cross_filesystem: The selected directory enters another disk or mount point, so StatusOrbit refused recursive deletion.
errors.cleanup_target_changed: A file changed after confirmation, so StatusOrbit deleted nothing. Cancel and review it again.
errors.cleanup_confirmation_unavailable: This confirmation is no longer available. Cancel and reopen the review.
errors.cleanup_confirmation_expired: This confirmation expired. Cancel and review the current files again.
errors.cleanup_target_unavailable: Some content no longer exists or cannot be accessed. Rescan and try again.
errors.invalid_cleanup_selection: The cleanup basket selection is invalid. Choose the items again.
errors.overlapping_cleanup_targets: A folder and one of its children are both selected. Keep only one level.

downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.description: May contain installers, documents, and files you still need.

trash.title: Trash
trash.description: Items are usually no longer recoverable after the trash is emptied.

app_cache.title: Application caches
app_cache.description: Apps may recreate or download this data again later.

developer_cache.title: Developer caches
developer_cache.description: Data that build tools and package managers can recreate.

hidden_data.title: Hidden user folders
hidden_data.description: Dot-prefixed app data and configuration. Measured only; direct cleanup is not recommended.

applications.title: Applications not used for a long time
applications.boundary: Only apps macOS confirms were unopened for at least six months; StatusOrbit never uninstalls them automatically
applications.none: No application could be confirmed as unused for more than six months.
applications.unavailable: This platform cannot currently provide reliable application last-use dates.
applications.unknownExcluded: {{count}} other apps have no confirmed last-use date, so StatusOrbit did not classify them as unused.

largestFiles: Large files on the system disk
largeFileBoundary: Only files over 500 MB are listed; automatic deletion is not recommended
noLargeFiles: No files over 500 MB were found in accessible system-disk locations.
unreadable: {{count}} locations were protected or temporarily unreadable. Only those locations are excluded from the result.
fullDiskAccessHint: On macOS, grant StatusOrbit Full Disk Access in System Settings → Privacy & Security, then scan again.
safetyBoundary: The scan has no time or item limit and never follows symbolic links. Only items placed in the basket, path-checked, and explicitly confirmed are permanently deleted, and they cannot be restored.
